chips.name: Custom words
chips.note: Names, jargon and product names you added get fixed on your Mac, before any model reads the text.

chips.name: Filler words
chips.note: Remove spoken hesitations with local cleanup, even when AI polish is off.

raw.t: I think we ship the beta on Friday

out.t: I think we ship the beta on Friday

chips.name: Self-corrections
chips.note: Say the correction out loud. AI polish can keep the version you meant.

chips.name: Numbers, dates & times
chips.note: English number formatting turns spoken values into the dates and times you would type.

chips.name: False starts
chips.note: AI polish can clean up repeated words and abandoned starts while keeping your thought.

raw.t: I was, I was thinking, I mean
maybe we skip the review this week

out.t: Maybe we skip the review this week.

chips.name: Punctuation & capitals
chips.note: AI polish tidies sentence boundaries, punctuation and capitalization.

raw.t: can you review the doc before standup thanks

out.t: an you review the doc before standup

chips.name: Emails, URLs & phones
chips.note: English number formatting can turn spoken contact details into written addresses and numbers.

chips.name: Spoken lists
chips.note: With a model that supports list formatting, a spoken list becomes easier to scan.

chips.name: Snippets
chips.note: Say your keyword and a phrase you saved drops in. It is the first thing that touches the text, before your custom words or anything else.

chips.name: Homophones
chips.note: Words that sound alike get the spelling your field actually uses.

chips.name: Spoken emoji
chips.note: Say the name of an emoji and you get the emoji. One setting keeps it literal.

chips.name: Paragraphs & structure
chips.note: AI polish can separate related thoughts into readable paragraphs, without adding new ideas.

raw.t: ok so the launch is on track we finished the installer docs are next also I want to redo the pricing page

out.t: The launch is on track. The installer is done and the docs are next.
, I want to redo the pricing page.

guards.name: Keeps your language
guards.note: Speak Spanish, get Spanish. Polish is set up only to tidy your words, not to translate them.

guards.name: Ignores commands
guards.note: Dictation is treated as text to write. The polish prompt tells the model not to follow instructions inside it.

guards.name: Catches runaway text
guards.note: Output checks can reject empty, repetitive or unusually long results and keep the cleaned transcript instead.

guards.name: A fallback if polish fails
guards.note: If AI polish fails or times out, EnviousWispr falls back to the last successful text.
